## What's Changed

* fix(core): harden trusted proxy and drain authorization, accept encrypted response includes, preserve non-strict tool schemas, recognize Business Pro Lite and Pro Max plans, and bound API-key limit cleanup by @Lok3rn3t in https://github.com/Soju06/codex-lb/pull/2729
* fix(proxy): preserve conversation context when an unknown WebSocket response anchor is lost, adapted from https://github.com/Soju06/codex-lb/pull/2731
* fix(proxy): recover complete same-account subagent context after an HTTP bridge reconnect, adapted from https://github.com/Soju06/codex-lb/pull/2581
* fix(proxy): notify native Codex clients when an idle upstream WebSocket loses its context, adapted from https://github.com/Soju06/codex-lb/pull/2636
* chore(deps): refresh Python, frontend, Rust and GitHub Actions dependencies, including compatibility updates for SQLAlchemy 2.1, i18next 27 and MSW 3.
* chore(metadata): refresh bundled model pricing and the Codex client version to 0.169.0.
* fix(release): retry transient startup connection resets, preserve container diagnostics, and upload Trivy results only when the report exists.
* build(distribution): publish the fork's Python packages, Linux amd64/arm64 Docker images, and Helm chart with the upstream CI checks and container smoke tests.

Thanks to the upstream contributors whose fixes and regression tests this release builds on. The canonical `previous_response_not_found` error remains available so Codex can recover a lost anchor using its full conversation history.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Lok3rn3t/codexLB-up/compare/v1.25.0-beta.10...v1.25.0
